title: Event Support Assistant Engineer
teaser: Event Support Assistant supporting technical operations of performances and events at CIS venues.
jd:
About the role
The Event Support Assistant supports the Event Support Engineer and is responsible for the smooth technical operations of performances, presentations, and other public events at various CIS performance venues.
Work Year: 12-month support staff schedule
Working Days: Monday to Friday, with occasional evening and Saturday work as scheduled or required
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, with flexibility required to support evening and weekend school events
Job Description
Supervise and monitor access to the performance venues as required and scheduled
Operate performance venue equipment as scheduled for event support
Provide and assist with live streaming or webinars for events if required
Assist other staff in supervising and maintaining the performance venues' sound, lighting, and electronic equipment
Assist staff with supervising the installation and execution of sound, lighting, and rigging designs
Monitor and maintain records of equipment
Help run a preventive maintenance program to maintain, repair, and replace all sound, stage lighting, electronic, video, and rigging equipment when required
Research and help implement new systems and technology so that the CIS performance spaces serve the needs of school programs
Assist in purchasing and budget functions, including recommending new equipment acquisitions
Attend meetings and rehearsals as scheduled
Work with primary and secondary performing arts teams to determine their needs for lighting, sound, and video during the development and rehearsal of productions
Serves as stage manager for productions when needed
Assist with the technical needs of rehearsals and performances as scheduled
Other duties
Attends meetings as scheduled.
Maintain all records, correspondence, etc., in a well-organized and accessible manner
Maintain strict confidentiality of all school and office records
Enforce and ensure compliance with the Chinese International School’s regulations pertaining to security, safety, and proper usage of school property
Ensure compliance with all school policies and procedures as related to the job responsibilities for this position
Relate courteously and effectively with students, parents, staff, and community members as necessary
Perform other technical support functions in the performing arts as assigned by relevant supervisors
Safety
Supervise the performance venues and ensure they are clean and organized after rehearsals, performances, meetings, assemblies, and ceremonies
Ensure that a safe and orderly work environment is maintained
Ensure safety guidelines at all times
Requirements
Diploma in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Technical Theatre, or other relevant diploma in performing arts technical support
Able to operate theatre lighting, sound, and video systems
Knowledgeable in theatre terms and definitions
Able to rectify and possibly take preventive maintenance of professional lighting, sound, and full-stage staging systems efficiently
Computer-literate, especially in theatre and live sound engineering-related software
Knowledge of stagecraft and the use of shop tools is an advantage
Positive work attitude and initiative.
Good English communication skills, both written and oral
Cantonese and/or Mandarin proficiency preferred
Good interpersonal skills, ability to work cooperatively, and ability to provide assistance to other team members as necessary
>
Attractive salary and excellent fringe benefits package will be offered to the right candidates. Interested parties please send FULL RESUME and COVER LETTER by clicking "Quick Apply".
Child Protection At Chinese International School
CIS adopts a strict zero-tolerance policy towards the mistreatment or abuse of children. The school's Child Protection Policy includes but is not limited to rigorous recruiting and vetting practices applicable to direct hires, contract staff, and all affiliated personnel, including volunteers. This may include a digital reference and background check.
All applicants should commit to comply with the CIS’s Child Protection Policy. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used for recruitment purposes only. All unsuccessful applications will be destroyed upon completion of the recruitment exercise.

teaser: Manage cutting-edge NVIDIA H800 & DGX Super POD clusters. Drive high-performance compute, networking, and Linux diagnostics for top-tier AI.

Deep dive into InfiniBand, RDMA, and Linux kernel diagnostics

jd:
About us
OneAsia is a leading IT services and solution provider in Asia providing cloud based solution as well as data centre services. OneAsia's top-tier rated data centres are located across Asia to keep customers connected from anywhere in the world with consistent levels of quality, security and service. Partnering with the technology leaders, OneAsia is able to offer a full range of cloud computing solutions, from infrastructure, management to application software to business of all sizes without additional capital investment or strong IT support. Flexibility, reliability, and security are the core values of OneAsia. With fully redundant infrastructure, well developed systems, multi-layered security and skilled personnel, OneAsia delivers professional and reliable services to customers.
Role Overview
The NVIDIA H800 Support Engineer manages enterprise-scale AI supercomputing environments. You will provide deep technical troubleshooting for NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD deployments. This role bridges advanced system administration, high-performance networking, and distributed AI software stacks.
Key Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve multi-node hardware and software failures across clusters.
Guide customer discussions on network design, compute/storage and support bring up of server/network/cluster deployments.
Troubleshoot and fine-tune ultra-high-bandwidth fabrics to maximize compute efficiency.
Perform deep-dive post-mortems on systemic bugs, node drops and cluster regressions.
Partner with vendor support teams to patch software bugs and system vulnerability.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.
3+ years in providing in-depth System support and debugging experience, strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize/multi-task easily with limited supervision.
System level expertise of CPU/GPU server architecture, NICs, Linux, system software and kernel drivers
Proven hands-on experience in Linux troubleshooting with good problem identification, resolution and solving skills.
Experience with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure tools (DCGM, nvidia-smi, MIG, NVSwitch diagnostics)
Hands-on experience with InfiniBand protocols, RDMA, and RoCEv2 architectures.
Experience with cluster orchestrators like Slurm or Kubernetes.
Proficiency in Bash and Python scripting for system monitoring and automation.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Slurm orchestrators, and tuning NVIDIA NCCL for distributed deep learning.
Experience with container technologies (Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, Kubernetes).
Exposure to high-throughput parallel filesystems like GPFS or Lustre.

title: Senior Integration Delivery Consultant [Forward Deployed Engineer]
teaser: An FDE is not primarily a pre-sales engineer or an advisory consultant. We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who loves building.
jd:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Integration Delivery Consultant - Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who loves building. You will work directly with enterprise customers to turn difficult, real-world problems into secure, working production systems. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with 5–10 years of experience who is equally comfortable writing code, connecting systems, troubleshooting production issues, and working side-by-side with customer teams. You will take a solution from an early problem statement through design, build, deployment, stabilization, and handover. An FDE is not primarily a pre-sales engineer or an advisory consultant. You will not stop at demos, slides, or recommendations. You will build the integrations, automation, workflows, and operational tooling needed to make the solution work in the customer's environment—and you will stay close to it until it does.
Key responsibilities
Start with the customer's problem, understand how their systems and teams operate, and turn ambiguity into a workable technical plan
Design pragmatic architectures that account for real constraints: legacy systems, fragmented data, network boundaries, security policies, compliance requirements, and delivery timelines
Write, test, review, debug, and maintain production-quality code
Build and deploy customer-specific solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments
Work directly with customer developers, architects, operations teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to unblock delivery
Troubleshoot issues across code, APIs, infrastructure, networking, identity, data, and third-party services
Make sound engineering trade-offs between speed, quality, security, maintainability, and customer impact
Explain technical choices, delivery risks, and outcomes clearly to both engineering teams and senior stakeholders
Mentor less-experienced engineers and help raise the quality of delivery practices, code, documentation, and reusable assets
About you
5–10 years of experience building and delivering software, cloud, data, automation, security, or AI solutions
A strong builder mindset: you enjoy getting hands-on, working through uncertainty, and shipping reliable outcomes rather than only producing recommendations
Proven experience taking technical solutions into production, ideally in customer or enterprise environments
Strong coding skills in Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or a similar language
Experience designing and integrating APIs, distributed systems, event-driven workflows, data services, or enterprise applications
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, or equivalent private-cloud environments
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, or similar tools
Solid understanding of networking, identity and access management, databases, secrets, security controls, observability, and production incident response
The ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, especially when explaining trade-offs, risks, and delivery decisions
Willingness to work closely with customers, including on-site engagement or travel when required
Nice to Have
Experience delivering solutions in financial services, healthcare, government, telecommunications, or other regulated and security-sensitive sectors.
Experience with observability, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and incident management.
Experience with AI/ML platforms, LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, AI governance, or AI security.
Experience implementing SSO, OAuth/OIDC, zero-trust controls, secrets management, encryption, audit logging, and network segmentation.
Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical delivery workstreams.
How You’ll Be Measured
You ship secure, reliable solutions that work in real customer environments.
Your deployments meet agreed functional, security, performance, and operational requirements.
Customers adopt what you build and achieve measurable operational or business value.
You identify delivery risks early, solve difficult technical problems, and help teams move forward.
Your work creates reusable patterns that make future customer deployments faster and better.
Application Requirements
Please submit a resume and cover letter.
In your cover letter, tell us:
Why you want to be a hands-on, customer-facing builder.
About one complex solution you personally built, integrated, or deployed into production.
What you owned technically, the stack you used, and the hardest problem you solved.
The outcome: reliability, performance, security, adoption, efficiency, or business impact.
How you balanced a customer’s immediate needs with long-term maintainability, security, and operational readiness.
>

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer
teaser: Secure one of HK's largest GPU clusters powering AI & HPC. Gain deep hands-on Linux, Kubernetes, and infrastructure security engineering experience.
jd:
We are looking for an Infrastructure Security Engineer to help secure one of Hong Kong's largest GPU computing environments, supporting cutting-edge Linux-based AI and High Performance Computing (HPC) workloads in a highly specialized on-premises environment.
This is a unique opportunity to gain real-world security engineering experience beyond traditional enterprise IT. You will work across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, vulnerability management, security operations, and infrastructure hardening while partnering with specialists from networking, HPC, AI, and platform engineering teams. In return, you will be exposed to large-scale GPU infrastructure, modern AI workloads, and enterprise-grade security practices, while being mentored by experienced security professionals with deep expertise in securing mission-critical environments.
If you enjoy taking ownership, solving technical challenges, and building secure infrastructure at scale, we'd love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Secure and maintain Linux-centric enterprise infrastructure operating within an HPC environment.
Manage the full vulnerability management lifecycle, including identification, assessment, remediation, verification, and reporting.
Review threat intelligence reports and assess potential impact to the organization's environment.
Review and analyse security alerts escalated by a managed SOC and coordinate appropriate remediation activities.
Apply security patches and fixes across infrastructure platforms and document operational procedures for engineers and operators.
Implement, review, and validate security hardening controls across:
Linux (particularly Ubuntu)
Windows Server
Kubernetes (K8s)
Support penetration testing engagements, vulnerability assessments, and security audits.
Collaborate with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams to continuously improve the organization's security posture.
Develop and maintain security documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
Required Experience
Minimum 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years in a Security Engineer or related cybersecurity role.
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including:
Network segregation and segmentation concepts
Firewall policy management
Linux iptables
Understanding of containerization and Kubernetes fundamentals, including:
Nodes
Pods
Containers
Strong Linux system administration experience, particularly with Ubuntu.
Experience securing and troubleshooting enterprise infrastructure.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach to security.
Preferred Experience
CISSP certification preferred.
Experience working with:
Kubernetes (K8s)
Enterprise firewalls
Splunk or other SIEM platforms
Experience with Windows administration and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with infrastructure hardening, vulnerability management, and security operations.
Experience supporting penetration testing and audit activities.
What You'll Get
Exposure to administering and securing one of Hong Kong's largest GPU clusters supporting AI and HPC workloads.
Mentorship from experienced security professionals with extensive expertise in enterprise infrastructure and cybersecurity.
Opportunities to develop practical skills across Linux security, Kubernetes security, vulnerability management, threat analysis, and infrastructure hardening.
Work alongside specialists from networking, HPC, AI, and platform engineering disciplines.
Hands-on experience securing mission-critical infrastructure that powers next-generation AI and research computing platforms.
A collaborative environment focused on technical excellence, continuous learning, and professional growth.
Why Join Us?
Unlike traditional security engineering roles that focus primarily on monitoring or compliance activities, this position provides direct exposure to securing large-scale GPU infrastructure, Linux platforms, and AI workloads in a highly specialized HPC environment. It's an opportunity to build deep technical expertise while working with cutting-edge technologies and experienced engineers across multiple domains.
Join us and help secure the infrastructure powering the next generation of AI and high-performance computing.

jd:
Job description:
>
> Position Summary We are seeking a qualified and experienced Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (Flight Engineer) to support the safe and efficient operation and maintenance of A319 aircraft.
The role combines in-flight technical support with aircraft maintenance responsibilities, including pre- and post-flight inspections, troubleshooting, defect rectification, and coordination of maintenance activities. The successful candidate will work closely with Flight Operations, CAMO, maintenance teams, ground handling providers, and technical service representatives to ensure the highest standards of aircraft safety, reliability, and operational readiness.
Main Responsibilities Provide technical support for aircraft operations in accordance with company procedures and CAMO instructions.
Conduct aircraft preparation and pre- and post-flight inspections.
Monitor aircraft technical status and report defects, irregularities, and maintenance requirements to the relevant teams.
Provide technical assistance to the cockpit and cabin crew as required.
Perform scheduled and unscheduled line maintenance in accordance with approved work orders and procedures.
Troubleshoot and rectify aircraft defects within the scope of applicable authorisations and procedures.
Support ground handling activities and coordinate aircraft servicing requirements with ground handling agents.
Operate as a flight crew member when required by Flight Operations and in accordance with applicable regulations.
Assist with the sourcing and procurement of aircraft parts and materials for scheduled and unscheduled maintenance.
Liaise with OEM and technical service representatives regarding aircraft technical issues.
Complete and maintain accurate maintenance records, work packages, and associated documentation.
Support the maintenance and serviceability of ground support equipment and monitor calibration requirements where applicable.
Perform inspection and certification duties within the scope of applicable authorisations and company procedures.
Ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations, maintenance manuals, quality procedures, and safety requirements.
Support audits, investigations, and other technical or operational activities as required.
Perform other duties as required to support the safe and efficient operation of the aircraft.
Minimum Requirements Relevant aircraft maintenance qualification, mechanical/technical apprenticeship, or equivalent aviation maintenance experience.
Valid aircraft maintenance licence, such as EASA Part-66 B1/B2, FAA A&P , or an equivalent licence recognised by the applicable aviation authority.
Relevant aircraft type ratings; A319/A320 family experience is highly desirable .
Additional aircraft type ratings are advantageous.
Previous experience in line maintenance, troubleshooting, and defect rectification.
Good understanding of aircraft maintenance procedures, aviation regulations, and safety standards.
Ability to read, understand, and complete technical documentation in English.
Strong technical communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to prioritise tasks effectively and work efficiently in a dynamic operational environment.
Strong safety awareness, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Flight Operations, CAMO, maintenance, and other stakeholders.
Desired Characteristics
Ability to manage critical deadlines effectively
Strong time management and organisational skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously
Positive, proactive, and can-do attitude
Strong attention to detail
Ability to work effectively under pressure and with minimal supervision
Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Work Environment The employee must be able to work in both a heavy maintenance environment and in upscale customer areas. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate with occasional high volume when aircrafts arrive/depart. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. Occasional fuel fumes may permeate the workplace. Employee must be willing and able to work in all types of weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. The Hangar environment may be extreme hot and cold during certain seasons of the year.

title: Software Engineer (Vibe Coding)
location: Tai Kok Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser: EVI creates platforms that live in kindergartens across the territory, helping the next generation of digital natives learn, grow, and thrive.
jd:
Company Overview
- EVI Services Limited creates platforms that live in kindergartens across the territory, helping the next generation of digital natives learn, grow, and thrive.
>
Job Highlights
- Position: Full-time
- Core Focus: AI-Assisted Development, Next-Gen Prototyping, AI R&D
- Location: Strictly Hong Kong-based (In-office)
- Education: Higher Diploma, Bachelor’s Degree or above (Postgraduate degrees welcome)
>
Background
Are you a builder who focuses on the "what" and the "why" rather than just the "how"? EVI Services Limited is looking for a full-time Software Engineer (Vibe Coding) to join our core development team. In this role, you won't just be grinding out manual syntax line-by-line; you will be orchestrating AI agents, LLMs, and modern IDEs to rapidly prototype, build, and ship production-ready features for our early childhood education platforms.
>
Key Responsibilities
- Rapid Prototyping & Production: Use advanced AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, v0, or internal EVI agents) to build, iterate, and deploy scalable educational modules.
- Prompt Engineering & Workflows: Design, test, and refine complex system prompts and agentic workflows to ensure code quality, optimal performance, and security.
- Legacy Integration: Act as the bridge between AI-generated components and our existing production codebases and databases.
- User-Centric Design: Focus heavily on the "vibe"—the UI/UX flow—ensuring our frontend tools remain incredibly intuitive for both teachers and young children.
>
Requirements
- Education: Holder of a Higher Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
- Research & R&D Experience: Demonstrated experience (academic or industry-focused) in researching, benchmarking, or experimenting with LLMs, prompt optimization methodologies, autonomous agents, or Human-AI collaboration frameworks. Experience writing research papers, technical reports, or a university thesis in an AI-related field is highly valued.
- The "Builder" Mindset: A strong portfolio of functional apps or side projects created using AI-assisted development workflows.
- Technical Literacy: While you focus on intent and system architecture, you must understand JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Python deeply enough to debug, review, and verify AI outputs.
- Critical Thinking: Strong "hallucination-checking" and code-reviewing skills to ensure business logic remains secure and sound.
- Communication: Fluent in English and Cantonese to effectively collaborate with our local product, design, and business teams.
>
Work Location & Eligibility
- Strict Location Requirement: This position is based permanently in Hong Kong.
- Candidates must be legally eligible to work and physically present in Hong Kong.
- No fully remote, offshore, or cross-border remote arrangements will be considered.
>
Interested parties, please send a full resume with availability, current and expected salary to us. All personal data collected would be used for recruitment purpose only.

jd:
關於我們的客戶
我們的客戶是香港一所信譽卓著的機電工程服務機構，擁有超過二十年行業經驗，專注於吊船、機械升降台等設備的安裝、維修、保養及安全測試。公司以「安全至上、技術為本」為核心價值，服務對象涵蓋各大物業管理公司、建築商及政府部門。
為配合業務持續發展，他們現正尋找一位具豐富經驗、有責任感及領導潛質的 高級吊船及升降台維修技工 / 科文 加入其專業技術團隊。
職位概要
您將成為團隊中的技術骨幹，不僅負責前線的維修與檢測工作，更有機會帶領小組處理突發任務。我們重視每一位成員的專業判斷，鼓勵自主決策，並提供足夠的彈性讓您發揮所長。在這裡，您不會只是「執行者」，而是解決問題的「專家」。
工作職責
負責日常吊船（永久吊船）及機械升降台的檢查、維修及保養，確保設備符合安全標準
協助進行防墜系統測試及起重裝置測試，並準確記錄測試數據
參與超重裝置的安裝、調試及校準工作
快速診斷設備故障，獨立或帶領團隊進行緊急維修
按需要指導及培訓初級技工，傳承實戰經驗（具管工經驗者將獲優先考慮）
入職要求
必須條件：
持有有效 吊船牌照
具備 最少3年 吊船及升降台維修保養實戰經驗
持有 建造業平安咭（平安卡）
優先考慮（非必須，但具備者將大大增加取錄機會）：
電工A牌
IPAF 升降台操作員 1A 及 3A 牌照
密閉空間核准工人證明書（密閉證）
1、2號車牌
OSHC / CIC 安全督導員證書
曾擔任管工（Foreman）或具監督經驗

DayOne builds and operates the data centers that AI, cloud, and digital economies run on. Diploma or above in Business Administration, Customer Service, or a related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, preferably with exposure to RMA/warranty handling and retail or showroom sales support.
Experience in electronics, FMCG, or consumer products industries is a strong advantage.
Strong understanding of RMA processes and after-sales service best practices.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle customer complaints and complex issues with empathy and professionalism.
Proficiency in spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin); fluency in additional languages is a plus.

teaser: Responsible for providing daily operational support for IT and audio-visual (AV) facilities in classrooms and laboratories.
bullet_points: Manage cutting-edge tech in a creative environment
2-year renewable role with medical & dental cover
jd:
PROJECT OFFICER
In a city renowned for its international outlook and connectivity, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) plays a unique and influential role in nurturing future generations of performing artists, including performers, practitioners, designers, and technicians. Ranked 10th in the 2026 QS World University Rankings for Performing Arts and 1st in Asia, the Academy and its Schools of Chinese Opera, Dance, Drama, Film & Television, Music, and Theatre & Entertainment Arts form a vibrant centre of practice, production, teaching, and practice-as-research. Its outstanding reputation is reinforced by the quality of its graduates and its partnerships with centres of excellence locally, regionally, and internationally. Through international residencies, visiting artists, and a distinguished alumni network—including some of the most respected professionals in their disciplines—the Academy is committed to training future world-class performers and practitioners.
Reporting to the Enterprise Systems Architect, the Project Officer is responsible for providing daily operational support for IT and audio-visual (AV) facilities in classrooms and laboratories during assigned evening, weekend, and public holiday shifts. The incumbent will set up, maintain, and troubleshoot interactive TVs, microphones, audio systems, computers, projectors, and other teaching-related equipment to ensure smooth classroom operations. They will provide first-line technical support to academic staff, students, and administrative users by responding to and resolving enquiries, incidents, and service requests in a timely manner. The role also involves conducting regular equipment inspections and preventive maintenance in classrooms and laboratories, as well as supporting both Windows and Mac environments, including software installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. In addition, the position assists with the setup and operation of IT and AV equipment for online meetings, webinars, hybrid events, video conferences, and virtual conferences, while providing on-site technical support for lectures, seminars, examinations, events, and special activities. The incumbent will also support live streaming and broadcasting platforms through system setup, operation, monitoring, and troubleshooting, and perform other IT administrative and support duties as assigned by the supervisors.
Requirements:
(a) A Higher Diploma or above in Information Technology, Computer Science, Multimedia Technology, Audio Visual Technology, or related disciplines.
(b) At least one year of relevant experience in IT support, Audio Visual support or technical services (Fresh graduates with strong technical knowledge may also be considered).
(c) Hands-on experience supporting Windows and Mac computers.
(d) Experience in supporting Audio Visual equipment, such as interactive displays, projectors, microphones, audio systems, video conferencing equipment and related peripherals.
(e) Basic knowledge of networking, including wired and wireless connectivity troubleshooting.
(f) Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Teams, Zoom and other online meeting platforms for video conferencing and virtual event support.
(g) Familiarity with live streaming and broadcasting platforms, including setup, operation, and technical support for online events and live productions.
(h) Ability to respond promptly to classroom and laboratory support requests during teaching sessions.
(i) Required to work on an evening, weekend and holiday schedule.
(j) Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
(k) Experience in the tertiary education sector or similar institutional environments is an advantage.
TERMS OF APPOINTMENT
Appointment will be on a two-year renewable contract, subject to performance and mutual agreement. A gratuity payment may be granted upon satisfactory completion of the full contract. Fringe benefits include leave, medical, and dental benefits. The starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
APPLICATIONS
To apply, please submit a completed Application Form (https://www.hkapa.edu/job-opportunity/project--officer) , together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae and copies of academic qualifications, to the Human Resources Office, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, No.1 Gloucester Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong, or email (••••@hkapa.edu ) on or before 25 August 2026. Completed application should be combined into one file in PDF format. Please quote reference code 'PjO' in the Application Form. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
HKAPA is an equal opportunity employer.
Personal data collected will be used for recruitment-related purposes only.

title: National Private Sector Engagement Officer
teaser: Join the IOM-UN Migration Agency to save lives and protect people on the move.
jd:
Introduction
Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.
>
>Organizational Context and Scope
IOM works with private sector actors on a broad range of IOM activities, including humanitarian assistance, health, labour migration and counter-trafficking. IOM’s interaction with the private sector is multifaceted; the Organization has received technological, financial, human resources and other support from the private sector to save and improve the lives of those that are most affected by conflicts or natural disasters, or those suffering from lack of opportunity. In addition, IOM partners with companies and foundations to help enhance its operational and strategic performance as well as to gather data and advocate regarding migration issues.
>
>IOM is recruiting National Private Engagement Officer in Hong Kong SAR, China
>
>Responsibilities
Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Mission, IOM China (based in Beijing), and in close coordination with the Head of Sub-Office in Hong Kong(SAR) and the Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, and with a technical reporting line to the Head of the Global Partnerships and Pipeline Development Unit within the Private Sector Partnerships (PSP) Division at Headquarters, the National Private Sector Engagement Officer will support strategic engagement with private sector actors based in Hong Kong SAR.
The incumbent will assist developing and managing high-value partnerships with corporates and philanthropic foundations to mobilize flexible funding, foster responsible business practices, and enable IOM’s strategic plan.
Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Support the implementation of the IOM Global Private Sector Strategy through targeted outreach, relationship management, and stewardship of private sector partners in Hong Kong SAR.
Collaborate with the Global Partnerships and Pipeline Development Unit within the Private Sector Partnerships (PSP) Division at Headquarters to identify, map, and prioritize new private sector prospects and expand existing partnerships for strategic and financial scale-up.
In coordination with COM and the Head of the Global Partnerships and Pipeline Development Unit within the Private Sector Partnerships (PSP) Division at Headquarters, contribute to design and implement a comprehensive private sector outreach and fundraising strategy for Hong Kong SAR, aligned with global and regional PSP priorities.
Develop and maintain a structured donor and partner database (Salesforce/Wave), ensuring systematic monitoring, reporting, and analysis of engagement and fundraising performance.
Assist to Strengthen cross-thematic private sector engagement across institutional and PSP’s thematic priorities, including climate change, regular pathways, emergencies, and flexible funding mechanisms in alignment.
Support to deliver initiatives that provide technical guidance to private sector partners on migration-related issues, including supply chain due diligence, ethical recruitment, employer responsibility, migrant rights, and inclusive business practices in Hong Kong SAR.
Assist with preparation of high-quality proposals, concept notes, and partnership materials tailored to private sector audiences.
Participate in private sector forums, roundtables, and strategic engagement platforms in Hong Kong SAR.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to partnership development, pipeline growth, and fundraising targets.
Work with the IOM team in Beijing to build synergy in private sector engagement between the mainland and Hong Kong SAR.
Collaborate with PSP Headquarters in the preparation of donor reports, partnership updates, monitoring and evaluation, and strategic communications.
Support regional PSP engagement efforts in Asia-Pacific, ensuring alignment between global, regional, and country-level private sector strategies.
Perform other duties as assigned.
>
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Master’s degree in business management, Political Science, Human Rights, International Relations, Marketing, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of professional experience; or,
University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Experience contributing to private sector partnership development and resource mobilization initiatives.
Understanding and experience of the Hong Kong and mainland China context and established track record in private sector partnership work in Hong Kong.
Understanding of private sector priorities and experience supporting partnerships development and fundraising with the private sector.
Experience in handling Corporate Social Responsibility programs and corporate recognition programs.
Experience contributing to identification of private sector opportunities and providing inputs to design and develop solutions with prospective partners for income and impact.
Experience supporting relationships management and coordinating with partners across multiple sectors.
Experienced in working cross-functionally and obtaining relevant content and information from different units to build innovative partnerships with private sector.
Experience in fundraising and donor engagement activities preferable within an international organization or UN context.
Skills
Demonstrated influencing skills and confidence to engage with high-level stakeholders.
Ability to meet fundraising targets and to negotiate and secure high value partnerships with corporates and foundations.
Proven ability to reconcile the needs of the Organization with those of the partner.
Ability to write, draft, and edit reports, acknowledgements, briefings, and donor correspondence when letters, proposals, grants, appeals and ability to explain complex issues to external donors and present the Organization and diverse operations in an appealing and concise manner.
Ability to develop Unique Value Proposition for private sector partners.
Languages
All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).
For this position, Native speaker of Chinese/Cantonese and fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another UN official language (Arabic, French, Russian and Spanish) is an advantage.
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

United Nation position grade NO-B

Application closing date is 17th September 2026. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Experience with Linux Kernel, U-Boot, RootFS, BusyBox and ARM Toolchains

title: Backend Software Engineer – EV Charging Systems
location: Lai Chi Kok, Sham Shui Po District
teaser: conduct research and experimental development on server-side systems supporting EV charger communication and charging-session processing.
jd:
About the Role
Dropcases Limited is developing technology solutions for the electric vehicle charging ecosystem, covering EV charging hardware, connected charging platforms, mobile applications and cloud-based services.
We are seeking a Backend Software Engineer – EV Charging Systems to conduct research and experimental development on server-side systems supporting EV charger communication and charging-session processing.
The role will focus on investigating and validating reliable backend mechanisms for handling concurrent charging sessions, asynchronous charger events, data consistency, system performance and recovery from partial network or service failures. The position is focused on backend R&D rather than routine software maintenance or mobile application development.
Key Responsibilities
● Review backend transaction flows and identify technical issues involving charger-event processing, concurrent requests, data consistency and service recovery.
● Research, develop and test Java-based backend prototypes for charger-event ingestion and charging-session state management.
● Investigate and compare approaches for event ordering, idempotency, deduplication, retries and transaction reconciliation.
● Conduct controlled load, concurrency and fault-recovery testing to assess response time, throughput, processing stability and transaction integrity.
● Investigate performance bottlenecks involving JVM processes, databases, caches, message queues and service-to-service communication.
● Develop and validate server-side recovery mechanisms for temporary network, service, database, cache or message-queue interruptions.
● Refine backend mechanisms based on test evidence and validate server-side API behaviour against defined system and interface requirements.
● Prepare prototype specifications, test records, benchmark results, technical findings and backend reliability recommendations.
● Participate in regular technical reviews and R&D milestone assessments.
● Collaborate with system architecture, mobile application, hardware and product teams on interface and integration requirements while maintaining responsibility for backend R&D deliverables.
Required Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
● At least five years of professional experience in Java backend or distributed-system development.
● Strong knowledge of Java, including concurrency, multithreading, input/output processing and JVM behaviour.
● Practical experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud or similar Java-based microservice frameworks.
● Experience with distributed systems, microservices and high-availability backend services.
● Experience with relational or distributed databases, caching systems and message queues.
● Familiarity with technologies such as MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
● Experience designing or testing APIs and service-to-service communication.
● Ability to investigate backend performance and reliability issues through structured testing and technical analysis.
● Strong problem-solving, documentation and cross-functional communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
● Experience with EV charging, IoT, connected devices or device-to-cloud platforms.
● Familiarity with EV charging communication protocols such as OCPP.
● Experience with Kubernetes, Docker or cloud-native deployment environments.
● Experience conducting load testing, performance benchmarking or fault-injection testing.
● Experience developing high-concurrency or fault-tolerant backend platforms.
● Experience participating in projects developed from initial concept or prototype stage.
Expected R&D Outputs
The successful candidate will contribute to the preparation of:
● Backend prototype modules;
● Charging-session processing and recovery mechanisms;
● Load, concurrency and fault-recovery test reports;
● Backend performance and reliability findings;
● Backend mechanism and reliability specifications;
● Technical documentation and internal knowledge-transfer materials.
Work Arrangement
The position will be based at Dropcases Limited’s Hong Kong office. The successful candidate will be provided with a dedicated workstation and access to the required backend development, cloud-computing, testing, source-control and performance-analysis environments.

Engineering planning and site coordination: Decompose monthly and weekly construction tasks according to the project master schedule, coordinate labour, materials, machinery and work surfaces, coordinate the insertion of civil, mechanical and professional subcontracting processes, track node deviations and drive corrective actions.
Technical management and process implementation: Participate in drawing reviews and construction scheme reviews, organise technical and safety briefings; implement measurement and setting out, axis elevation verification and process control of key processes such as reinforcement, formwork, concrete and masonry.
Quality, safety and risk management: Coordinate material entry inspection, actual measurement, process reporting and acceptance of concealed works; conduct risk inspections of temporary power, high-altitude work, scaffolding and lifting operations, establish problem registers and complete corrective closure.

Acceptance, delivery and documentation management: Coordinate construction logs, inspection batches, acceptance records and corrective documents, cooperate with phase acceptance, completion delivery and defect follow-up, ensure site progress, quality status and engineering documentation synchronised closure.
About you
Bachelor's degree or above, 5 or more years of experience in residential building, civil construction or engineering site management.
Familiar with construction drawings, main residential building processes, measurement verification, technical briefings, progress planning, quality acceptance and construction documentation management, able to independently drive site problem analysis and corrective implementation.
Familiar with building engineering quality, safety and civilised construction management requirements.
Good planning execution, multi-party coordination, resource integration and risk prediction ability, strong sense of responsibility, results-oriented, able to maintain effective delivery under multi-trade crossing and schedule pressure.
Able to adapt to construction site work pace and cross-regional project collaboration.
About us
Teng Mao Engineering Limited is a professional building engineering company registered in Hong Kong. Due to business development and key project construction management needs, we are now recruiting professional talents with solid residential building construction experience, quality and safety awareness and on-site coordination ability to join and drive building engineering projects to be implemented on schedule, with high quality and safety.

title: R&D Software Engineer – Automated 3D Navigation for Pipeline Robotics
teaser: Bonbon-X Limited is developing underground pipeline inspection robots for real-world deployment. Automated navigation inside pipelines is...
jd:
Job Nature: Research and Development position under the Research Talent Hub scheme
Job Objective
The R&D Engineer will focus on the study and development of automated 3D navigation technologies for underground pipeline inspection robots. The role aims to improve the robot’s ability to understand its position, movement, orientation, pipeline geometry, and inspection path inside confined and GPS-denied pipeline environments.
The candidate will support Bonbon-X Limited in developing a more intelligent pipeline robotic platform capable of semi-autonomous or automated navigation, sensor-based localisation, 3D path reconstruction, real-time telemetry, and reliable field deployment in complex underground pipe networks.
Key Responsibilities
Research and develop automated 3D navigation methods for pipeline inspection robots operating in confined, dark, narrow, and GPS-denied pipe environments.
Study and implement sensor-fusion methods using data from wheel odometry, IMU, camera, LiDAR, depth sensor, encoder, or other onboard sensors to estimate robot position, orientation, movement trajectory, and pipe geometry.
Develop software modules for robotic localisation, mapping, path tracking, 3D trajectory reconstruction, obstacle detection, and navigation decision support.
Evaluate ROS / ROS2-based navigation frameworks, including SLAM, navigation stack, path planning, sensor drivers, and robot middleware, and assess their suitability for Bonbon-X’s pipeline robot platform.
Build Python / C++ software tools for robot control, data acquisition, live monitoring, sensor calibration, navigation testing, and field-test diagnostics.
Develop real-time data streaming and visualisation tools to display robot movement status, sensor readings, inspection path, navigation data, and system health during laboratory and field tests.
Support integration of edge computing platforms, embedded controllers, onboard sensors, communication modules, and robot control systems.
Design and conduct laboratory experiments to validate navigation accuracy, movement stability, sensor reliability, communication latency, and autonomous navigation performance.
Participate in field trials of pipeline inspection robots, collect test data, analyse navigation failure cases, and propose engineering improvements.
Prepare technical documentation, test reports, experiment records, system diagrams, software notes, and R&D progress reports for internal review and RTH project reporting.
Research Focus Areas
The candidate will mainly work on the following research areas:
Automated 3D navigation inside underground pipelines.
Robotic localisation in GPS-denied pipe environments.
Sensor fusion for pipeline robot movement and orientation estimation.
ROS / ROS2 navigation framework adaptation for compact pipeline robots.
3D pipeline path reconstruction and inspection route mapping.
Real-time telemetry and diagnostic software for field deployment.
Navigation reliability improvement for bends, slopes, wet surfaces, long-distance inspection, and confined pipe structures.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Applied Physics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related STEM discipline.
Experience in robotics software development, embedded systems, sensor integration, automation, or robotic control.
Knowledge of Python and / or C++ programming.
Experience with Linux-based development environments.
Familiarity with ROS / ROS2, SLAM, robot navigation, mobile robots, AGV systems, LiDAR, camera systems, IMU, Raspberry Pi, Jetson, ESP32, Arduino, or similar platforms would be an advantage.
Ability to conduct experiments, analyse technical problems, document engineering results, and support real-world system testing.
Preferred Experience
Experience in AGV, mobile robot, TurtleBot, Jetson-based robot, ROS / ROS2 navigation, LiDAR mapping, or mobile mapping projects.
Experience in sensor data acquisition, real-time data visualisation, hardware debugging, or field-testing tools.
Experience in underground, industrial, inspection, confined-space, or harsh-environment robotics would be an advantage.
Knowledge of AI-assisted robot control, edge computing, computer vision, or 3D reconstruction would be a plus.
Good command of Cantonese, Mandarin, and English for technical communication, supplier coordination, customer discussion, and documentation.
Expected R&D Deliverables
Prototype software module for pipeline robot navigation and localisation.
Sensor integration and data acquisition framework for navigation-related testing.
Experimental setup for validating 3D navigation accuracy and robot movement trajectory.
Real-time monitoring and visualisation tool for robot status and navigation data.
Field-test reports analysing navigation performance, failure cases, and improvement directions.
Technical documentation supporting future product development and commercial deployment of Bonbon-X pipeline inspection robots.
Relevance to Bonbon-X Limited
Bonbon-X Limited is developing underground pipeline inspection robots for real-world deployment. Automated navigation inside pipelines is technically challenging because the robot operates in a confined, dark, wet, GPS-denied, and structurally repetitive environment. The company therefore requires R&D talent who can combine robotics software, sensor integration, embedded systems, mapping, real-time data tools, and practical field-testing capability.
This position will strengthen the company’s ability to develop reliable navigation functions, improve inspection efficiency, reduce operator workload, and support the long-term development of intelligent and semi-autonomous pipeline robotic systems.

Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.

title: Part-Time Web & Graphic Designer
teaser: Looking for a designer to create strong visual assets and independently update Shopify & WordPress.
jd:
Role Overview
We are looking for a versatile Part-Time Web & Graphic Designer to support the day-to-day visual and digital execution of Auraecell across e-commerce, website, social media, advertising and print. The role combines graphic design with practical Shopify and WordPress management, allowing campaign ideas and brand updates to move quickly from concept to live execution.
You should be comfortable receiving a brief, designing the required assets, updating the relevant web pages, and preparing final artwork for digital or print use with minimal supervision. Advanced software development is not the focus of this position.
The role works closely with the internal marketing and creative team. Campaign direction, copy and priorities will be provided internally. Your responsibility is to translate these into polished visual assets, keep website content current, and ensure digital and print materials are delivered accurately and on time.
>
Key Responsibilities
Website & E-commerce
Maintain and update Shopify and WordPress pages, content and visual assets.
Create or modify landing pages for product launches, Meta Ads and campaigns.
Update products, images, copy, pricing, banners and promotional sections.
Check desktop and mobile layouts and correct basic display or formatting issues.
Troubleshoot routine website issues and coordinate with external developers when advanced technical work is required.
Graphic Design & Production
Create social media graphics, carousels, static Meta Ads and campaign assets.
Design website banners, product graphics, infographics and promotional visuals.
Adapt key visuals into multiple digital sizes and platform formats.
Prepare brochures, leaflets, posters, inserts, packaging amendments and other print collateral.
Prepare print-ready files and liaise with printers or suppliers when required.
>
Qualifications & Requirements
Strong visual design ability - A clean portfolio showing good typography, layout, hierarchy and brand consistency.
Practical Shopify and WordPress experience - Able to make routine page, product and content updates without relying on a developer. Basic HTML/CSS knowledge.
Working experience with design tools - Ability to create both digital and print-ready artwork using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or equivalent professional tools. Experience with Figma or similar interface-design tools is a plus.
Digital marketing awareness - Understands that design assets need to work across landing pages, social content and paid advertising. Experience with e-commerce landing pages and conversion-focused design, and experience creating Meta Ads or paid-social assets is a plus.
Speed and reliability - Comfortable working to campaign deadlines and turning around revisions efficiently.
Print production knowledge - Understands dimensions, bleed, resolution, colour setup and final-artwork preparation. Experience coordinating directly with printers or production suppliers
Independent working style - Able to take a clear brief and complete routine execution with minimal supervision.
Bilingual communication - Fluent spoken English and Cantonese, with the ability to coordinate clearly with internal teams, printers, suppliers and external technical support.
Part-time - Available approximately 2-3 days per week
Interest in wellness, supplements or lifestyle brands is a plus
>
Application
Please submit your CV and portfolio, including examples of graphic design work and, where possible, Shopify or WordPress pages you have designed or maintained. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate both strong visual judgment and practical hands-on execution.
>

title: R&D Deputy General Manager
teaser: Watson Biotech (Hong Kong R&D Center, Hong Kong Science Park) is recruiting an R&D Deputy General Manager focused on CTC liquid biopsy and tumor...
jd:
Position Description
Watson Biotech (Hong Kong R&D Center, Hong Kong Science Park) is recruiting an R&D Deputy General Manager focused on CTC liquid biopsy and tumor IVD in vitro diagnostics. This senior technical role is responsible for the Hong Kong R&D team’s daily work, carrying out core technology iteration, innovative product development and clinical transformation of CTC detection and tumor liquid biopsy product lines. This position concentrates on hands-on technical breakthroughs and pipeline innovation to consolidate the company’s technical advantages in tumor diagnostics and support long-term technical strategy.
Responsibilities
Role focuses on hands-on technical R&D and innovation
1.Technical Strategy & Roadmap : Responsible for tracking cutting-edge trends and technical bottlenecks in CTC and tumor liquid biopsy sectors; conduct formulation of product technical roadmaps, carry out iteration of existing products and pre-research of new technologies to sustain the company’s technical competitiveness.
2.Full-cycle Technical R&D : Responsible for end-to-end technical R&D of CTC and liquid biopsy IVD products, conduct solution design, experimental verification, parameter optimization and performance validation in person. Perform all R&D work in compliance with ISO13485 and relevant regulatory standards; tackle key technical bottlenecks independently to guarantee stable technical delivery of all projects.
3.Innovation & Patent Layout : Responsible for technical innovation in frontier directions including CTC organoid culture and AI-assisted interpretation; conduct sorting and refinement of core technologies, carry out intellectual property patent deployment to build the company’s proprietary technical barriers.
4.Clinical Transformation & Verification : Responsible for pre-clinical and clinical technical verification work; conduct optimization of product technical schemes based on real clinical data, perform troubleshooting for technical barriers during the transformation from lab experimental technology to commercial IVD products.
5.Technical Standardization & Industrial Landing : Responsible for establishing standardized R&D technical specifications for liquid biopsy products; conduct cross-department coordination with clinical, regulatory and production teams, perform resolution of technical problems emerging in product registration and industrialization, and maintain stable technical performance of mass-produced launched products.
Responsible for other technical innovation tasks assigned by senior management.
Requirements
1.Education : Master’s degree or above in Biology, Immunology, Medicine, Clinical Laboratory Science or other biomedical related majors, with solid theoretical foundation in tumor diagnosis and cellular immunology.
2.Core Experience : Over 10 years of IVD tumor diagnosis R&D experience, including no less than 3 years of senior technical post experience. Candidates must have proven track records of independently conducting full-cycle R&D and pushing successful commercialization of CTC/tumor liquid biopsy products.
3.Professional Skills : Proficient in cellular immunology-based IVD technologies (immunofluorescence, immunomagnetic bead technology, ELISA, etc.). Candidates who can conduct development of microfluidic chips and matching supporting instruments are highly preferred; familiar with hands-on operation of CTC organoid culture and AI-assisted diagnosis technologies.
4.Technical Competence : Able to conduct construction of complete liquid biopsy technical systems and carry out management of multiple parallel R&D projects. Possess acute industry insight to identify technical risks, conduct optimization of R&D solutions and deliver high-quality technical achievements on schedule.
5.Comprehensive Quality : Strong technical communication and cross-team collaboration capabilities. Rigorous research attitude, proactive hands-on problem-solving ability, innovative thinking, and capability to conduct target delivery of technical indicators under tight working pressure.
